Chapter 6531: From Death To Life

Chapter 6531: From Death To Life

\The shock came from Bao Pu being a revered figure but more importantly, would eating an immortal be enough to improve one’s cultivation to the same realm?

Becoming an emperor was hard enough, let alone the subsequent realms. The immortal realm wasn’t on people’s mind at all. Now, what would happen if they were to eat an immortal?

This freaked out powerful cultivators. If Bao Pu had done it once, he might try to do so again.

How many immortals were around currently? Desolate Ancestor, masters of the redemption grounds, and the reborn Zhan Sansheng. Would he aim for any of them?

Or when immortal corpses aren’t available, would he go for the overlords instead? He would have no difficulties hunting them down.

“He deserves death.” An overlord said. Alas, this was easier said than done.

In their opinion, Desolate Ancestor was the only one who could kill him. The masters of the redemption ground didn’t care about worldly affairs.

By this time, the fourth mantra manifested - the Lord of Life and Death warps from death to life, verging immortal ascension.

“Another immortal?” No one doubted this possibility.

Some shuddered while others became excited.

“The lord is qualified to become an immortal.” Desolate gods and emperors didn’t find this surprising.

“From death to life?” Many wondered about the process.

“So death to reincarnation to life?” Everyone was curious.

“Not a true death. I believe it was life to death last time and now death to life.” A desolate god heard some legends previously.

“Is there a reason for this?” Someone asked.

Few in history had the privilege of seeing her due to her reclusiveness. Nevertheless, her status and authority were second to none. Even overlords would follow her call.

No one understood the historical reason for her influence and why Desolate Ancestor was her protector.

Legends spoke of her ability to control the reincarnation cycle and the two spheres of existence. Some had more information that although she didn’t have total control, she could actually grant rebirth.

“Do you know why she went from life to death last time?” A curious soul asked her ancestor.

The primal ancestor answered: “It most likely had something to do with Bodhi Ancestor.”

“Oh?” The junior didn’t know of this tale.

“As far as I know, Bodhi Ancestor failed the ascension and was killed by a heavenly tribulation. However, the lord interfered and saved him using from death to life. Unfortunately, she endured death as a result.” The ancestor explained.

A heaven-slayer nearby disagreed and shook his head: “There’s no saving anyone from a heavenly tribulation. This was for Li Xingchen slain by Poye during Nightwatch.”

“Either way, another war is starting.” The group gazed in the direction of Supreme Heaven.

It went all out last time to prevent Bodhi Ancestor’s ascension. Would the same all-out assault occur the same?

“They have to.” A big shot said.

“They can’t compete when the other party has two immortals.” Another said, believing this was an existential crisis for Supreme Heaven.

Those within Supreme Heaven became anxious. Many wanted to ask Weizhen for guidance but he was nowhere to be found.

***

The news from Xian Chengtian took the form of truth mantras so people believed him.

Those affected by the news didn’t respond. This added to their validity.

“Why is Xian Chengtian doing this?” Everyone shared the same topic.

Of course, this was his not first time revealing secrets. However, it was limited to his masters then.

“He’s courting death.” Another said.

Now, he offended both heavens and the redemption grounds. He made enemies of everyone in Three Immortals.
